categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在模型可信度与不确定性量化、持续学习与多模态基座模型，以及AI合规与评测基准的构建。

articles.title: When to Trust Simulated Patient Responses:Support-Gated World Models for Vasopressor Decision Support
articles.zh: 何时该信任模拟病人响应：面向升压药决策支持的支持门控世界模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做医疗决策支持或世界模型，这篇提醒你别无条件相信模型模拟出来的病人反应，得先判断它有没有证据支撑。
articles.author: Yifan Jin, Tao Liu
articles.body: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate alone.These results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.
articles.bodyZh: 临床世界模型（clinical world models）会让语言模型智能体（language-model agents）去面对预测出来的患者反应，但碰上证据支撑很弱的治疗方案，或者不熟悉的医院，这种模拟可能不太靠得住。我们提出一种“支持门控世界模型决策支持”（Support-Gated World-Model decision support），它是在“提议—模拟—修正”（propose–simulate–refine）智能体上做的轻量扩展。一个循环动力学集成模型（recurrent dynamics ensemble）会根据有记录的去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine）剂量类别，预测短时间内的生理反应；同时一个行为模型（behavior model）会估计观察数据里某个动作有多少支持，也就是观察性动作支持（observational action support）。界面会把支持不够、或者集成模型分歧太大的预测先压住不输出；如果没有任何候选动作够格，就直接弃权（abstain）。在 eICU-CRD 上的评估覆盖 70 家医院、30,700 个决策转换（decision transitions），其中 14 家医院留作测试。在真实转换覆盖率（factual-transition coverage）为 62.0% 时，联合门控（joint gating）给出的平均动脉压（MAP）平均绝对误差是 7.3 mmHg，而在同样覆盖率下随机选择是 9.2 mmHg。门控智能体在决策覆盖率（decision coverage）达到 81.0% 时，与记录动作的一致率是 60.0%；相比之下，不门控的集成智能体（ungated ensemble agent）一致率是 55.0%、覆盖率是 99.5%。组件消融（component ablations）显示，联合门控的真实风险（factual risk）比单独用任何一个门控都低。这些结果刻画的是选择性临床模拟（selective clinical simulation）里的可靠性—覆盖率权衡（reliability–coverage trade-off）；它们既不能识别个体化治疗效果，也不能证明患者结局有改善。

articles.title: Black-Box Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Ensemble-of-Ensembles
articles.zh: 通过"集成之集成"实现大语言模型的黑盒不确定性量化
articles.summary: 如果你只能通过API调模型、拿不到logits，这套多次采样再集成的办法能给你一个可用的置信度估计。
articles.author: Wang Ma, Debarun Bhattacharjya 等
articles.body: Reliable use of large language models (LLMs) requires uncertainty estimates that separate ambiguity intrinsic to a prompt from genuine knowledge gaps. Bayesian and deep-ensemble methods deliver this aleatoric/epistemic decomposition in principle, but are computationally prohibitive at LLM scale and require white-box access. Existing black-box methods, in contrast, summarize to a single scalar that cannot make the distinction. We introduce a two-level ensemble that bridges this gap. Stochastic decoding of a fixed prompt forms the inner ensemble; meaning-preserving semantic perturbations of the prompt form the outer ensemble. Variability is measured in a continuous embedding space, and the law of total covariance gives an exact within-/between-perturbation decomposition to estimate aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty (AU/EU); it requires only black-box sampling access. On top of this estimator, we contribute three theoretical results that ground the framework: (i) a finite-sample bias identity for nested Monte Carlo with a closed-form bias-corrected epistemic estimator; (ii) a Bayesian bridge bounding the gap between perturbation-population AU/EU and Bayesian targets; and (iii) a separation result identifying a class of failure modes that any consistency-only black-box method provably misses while perturbation-based EU detects. Across five short QA benchmarks and four instruction-tuned LLMs spanning two families and two scales, our estimator is competitive with strong white-box baselines, and at a matched generation budget it matches leading black-box methods on error ranking while decomposing AU and EU; controlled paired interventions show that AU and EU respond selectively to distinct, actionable sources of failure: prompt ambiguity and model knowledge gaps; and a long-form pilot on the NQ long-answer split shows the framework extends to claim-level factuality without retraining.
articles.bodyZh: 要想放心地用大语言模型（LLMs），我们得有一套不确定度估计，能把“提示词本身带来的歧义”和“模型真的不知道”这两件事分开。贝叶斯方法和深度集成方法原则上能做到这种偶然不确定性/认知不确定性分解（aleatoric/epistemic decomposition），但放到 LLM 这个规模上，计算成本高得离谱，而且还得能白盒访问模型。现有黑盒方法就不一样了，它们最后只给一个单一标量（scalar），根本分不开这两类不确定性。我们提出一个两级集成（two-level ensemble）来补上这个缺口。对同一个提示词做随机解码（stochastic decoding），构成内层集成；对提示词做保持语义的扰动（meaning-preserving semantic perturbations），构成外层集成。我们在连续嵌入空间（continuous embedding space）里衡量变化，再用全协方差定律（law of total covariance）做精确的扰动内/扰动间分解（within-/between-perturbation decomposition），估出偶然不确定性和认知不确定性（AU/EU）；而且只需要黑盒采样访问（black-box sampling access）就行。在这个估计器之上，我们还给了三个理论结果，把这个框架撑住：第一，针对嵌套蒙特卡洛（nested Monte Carlo）的有限样本偏差恒等式（finite-sample bias identity），并给出闭式偏差校正认知估计器（closed-form bias-corrected epistemic estimator）；第二，一个贝叶斯桥接（Bayesian bridge），给扰动总体 AU/EU 和贝叶斯目标（Bayesian targets）之间的差距划出界限；第三，一个分离结果（separation result），指出有一类失效模式（failure modes），任何只靠一致性的黑盒方法（consistency-only black-box method）都可证明会漏掉，而基于扰动的 EU 能检测到。在五个短问答基准（short QA benchmarks）和四个指令微调大语言模型（instruction-tuned LLMs）上——覆盖两个模型家族、两个规模——我们的估计器跟强白盒基线（white-box baselines）比很有竞争力；在相同生成预算（matched generation budget）下，它在错误排序（error ranking）上追平领先的黑盒方法，同时还能把 AU 和 EU 分开。受控配对干预（controlled paired interventions）显示，AU 和 EU 会分别有选择地响应不同且可操作的失败来源：提示歧义（prompt ambiguity）和模型知识缺口（model knowledge gaps）。另外，在 NQ 长答案划分（NQ long-answer split）上做的长文本试点（long-form pilot）表明，这个框架不用重新训练也能扩展到声明级事实性（claim-level factuality）。

articles.title: Between Obligations and Evidence: A Participatory Study of Translating the EU AI Act into Technical Requirements
articles.zh: 在义务与证据之间：将 EU AI Act 转化为技术要求的参与式研究
articles.summary: 如果你要给产品做AI合规，这篇说明法规条文和技术实现之间还隔着一条鸿沟，别指望照着条款逐条翻译就能落地。
articles.author: Helma Torkamaan, Masoud Mansoury 等
articles.body: The EU AI Act imposes technical and organizational requirements for high-risk AI systems, but applying these requirements involves contextual choices about what to measure and what evidence supports a compliance claim. We investigate these challenges through a participatory workshop involving 32 researchers, policymakers, and practitioners from different disciplines, using realistic scenarios in healthcare, recruitment, and public transport to examine how regulatory obligations are interpreted, translated into technical requirements, and evaluated in practice. Through a thematic analysis of workshop data, we identify recurring tensions between how regulatory obligations are translated into measurable system properties, how responsibility and human oversight are exercised in practice, and how the validity of compliance evidence is affected by changing operational conditions and system uses. For example, participants highlighted how fairness metrics could conceal discrimination in recruitment, how time pressure and limited information could undermine human oversight in public transport, and how changes in patient populations could invalidate previously established evidence of system performance. Our findings suggest that technical, organizational, and evidentiary challenges are interdependent, and that establishing and maintaining compliance requires attention not only to technical assessments but also to how AI systems are used, governed, and monitored over time. We discuss implications for supporting context-sensitive and ongoing compliance.
articles.bodyZh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》(EU AI Act)给高风险人工智能系统(high-risk AI systems)定下了技术和组织上的要求(technical and organizational requirements)，但真要照着做，就得结合具体情境做判断：到底该测什么，又该拿什么证据来支撑“我们合规”这个主张(compliance claim)。我们办了一场参与式研讨会(participatory workshop)，请来32位来自不同学科的研究者、政策制定者和一线从业者，用医疗、招聘和公共交通里的现实场景，看看监管义务到底怎么被理解、怎么变成技术要求、又在实际中怎么被评估。通过对研讨会数据做主题分析(thematic analysis)，我们发现有几类矛盾反复出现：监管义务怎么转成可衡量的系统属性(measurable system properties)；责任和人类监督(human oversight)在实际中怎么落实；合规证据的有效性(validity of compliance evidence)又怎么被运行条件和系统用途的变化影响。比如，参与者提到，公平性指标(fairness metrics)可能把招聘中的歧视藏起来；时间紧、信息少，可能让公共交通里的人类监督打折扣；患者群体一变，之前证明系统表现的那些证据可能就失效了。我们的发现说明，技术、组织和证据层面的难题是相互牵连的，要想建立并维持合规，不能只盯着技术评估，还得关注AI系统长期怎么被使用、怎么被治理、怎么被监测。最后我们讨论了这些发现对支持“看情境、持续做”的合规(context-sensitive and ongoing compliance)有什么启发。

articles.title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
articles.zh: 基于单通道脑电的可解释睡眠分期分类
articles.summary: 如果你关注可穿戴睡眠监测，这篇说明单通道EEG也能做分期并给出解释，但别指望它能替代多导睡眠图。
articles.author: Gurinder Kaur Sandhu, Jude Koenig 等
articles.body: Automated sleep staging has achieved strong bench- mark accuracy; however, clinical adoption remains limited due to a lack of interpretability. In this work, we fill the research gap by extending the SleepXAI sleep staging framework to systematically compare five different XAI methods. Further, attribution fidelity is evaluated using Spearman rank correlation with AASM-defined EEG frequency bands, serving as clinically grounded reference signals. In this paper, we focus on single- channel Electroencephalogram (EEG), which is more amenable to practical clinical deployment compared to full polysomnography setups. Experiments are conducted on the Sleep-EDF benchmark dataset and the DREAMT dataset. In DREAMT, we stratified subjects based on OSA into four Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) severity groups. We observed that the SleepXAI model achieves strong classification performance on both datasets. Among the evaluated methods, Integrated Gradients (IG) consistently achieves the highest mean attribution fidelity across all five sleep stages on Sleep-EDF and across all AHI groups on DREAMT, outperforming all other evaluated methods under the Spearman rank correlation metric. These findings highlight the importance of attribution method selection as a key factor for ensuring reliable and clinically interpretable automated sleep staging systems.
articles.bodyZh: 自动睡眠分期（automated sleep staging）在基准测试上已经能达到很高的准确率，但临床上真正用起来还是不多，主要卡在可解释性不够。我们这项研究就是想补上这个缺口：把 SleepXAI 睡眠分期框架扩展一下，系统地比较五种不同的可解释人工智能（XAI）方法。接着，我们用斯皮尔曼秩相关（Spearman rank correlation），拿美国睡眠医学会（AASM）定义的脑电（EEG）频带来做参照信号，评估归因保真度（attribution fidelity），这些频带可以当成有临床依据的参考。本文重点看单通道脑电图（EEG），因为跟完整的多导睡眠图（polysomnography）设置相比，它更适合实际临床部署。实验在 Sleep-EDF 基准数据集和 DREAMT 数据集上做。在 DREAMT 里，我们按阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（OSA）把受试者分成四个呼吸暂停低通气指数（AHI）严重程度组。结果看到，SleepXAI 模型在两个数据集上分类性能都很强。在评估的这些方法里，积分梯度（Integrated Gradients, IG）在 Sleep-EDF 的全部五个睡眠阶段上，以及在 DREAMT 的全部 AHI 分组上，平均归因保真度都稳定最高；在斯皮尔曼秩相关指标下，它也优于所有其他被评估的方法。这些发现说明，选哪种归因方法很关键，它直接关系到自动睡眠分期系统能不能做到可靠、并且临床上可解释。

articles.title: LECAT: Measuring LLM Category Learning from Pretraining Data
articles.zh: LECAT：衡量 LLM 从预训练数据中学习类别的能力
articles.summary: 如果你想搞清楚模型的分类能力到底来自预训练还是指令微调，这个基准能帮你把两者拆开看。
articles.author: Jimin Mun, Maarten Sap 等
articles.body: Humans know that airplanes are fast, that this extends to red airplanes, but that it does not hold for broken airplanes. How do LLMs acquire category knowledge that humans learn and apply effortlessly? We introduce LeCat, a two-part framework to analyze LLM's Learning of Category knowledge. First, we use LeCat to evaluate models on their ability to learn category knowledge, distinguishing between three cases: memorization of in-domain category knowledge, generalization to unseen instances, and ability to flexibly use knowledge in appropriate contexts. Then, we use LeCat to trace how this knowledge can be learned in pretraining from text that may encode category knowledge in various ways, such as verbatim repetition or exceptions, which we refer to as forms of "knowledge expression". We first assess open-source pretrained models using 199 curated category-feature pairs and analyze their training data. Our findings suggest that strengthening context and category-feature co-occurrence likelihood (PMI) improve learning for larger models and verbatim rule-like statements diminish flexible category learning. To systematically isolate these effects, we then train a 68M model from scratch with precise control over the categorical information each sees in their training data, confirming that verbatim repetition reduces flexible learning but mixture of diverse knowledge expressions lead to more robust category learning. Together, our findings highlight that while contextual flexibility is persistently difficult for models, how category knowledge is expressed in pretraining greatly impacts models' acquisition of robust category knowledge.
articles.bodyZh: 人类知道飞机飞得快，也知道红色飞机同样快，可坏掉的飞机就不一定了。那大语言模型（LLMs）是怎么学会这种人类学起来、用起来都不费劲的类别知识（category knowledge）的呢？我们提出LeCat，一个分成两部分的框架，用来分析大语言模型对类别知识的学习。第一步，我们用LeCat评估模型学习类别知识的能力，并把情况分成三类：记住领域内的类别知识（memorization）、泛化（generalization）到没见过的实例，以及在合适语境里灵活运用知识。第二步，我们用LeCat追查这类知识在预训练（pretraining）中是怎么从文本里学到的——文本可能用各种方式把类别知识编码进去，比如逐字重复（verbatim repetition），或者列出例外，我们把这些方式叫作“知识表达”（knowledge expression）的不同形式。我们先拿199个精心整理的“类别—特征”对，评估开源预训练模型，并分析它们的训练数据。结果发现，增强上下文和“类别—特征”共现的可能性（PMI），能让更大的模型学得更好；而逐字重复、像规则一样的陈述，会削弱灵活的类别学习。为了把这些效应系统地拆开，我们又从零训练了一个6800万参数的模型，精确控制它在训练数据里看到的类别信息（categorical information），结果证实：逐字重复会减少灵活学习，而混合多种知识表达，会带来更稳健的类别学习。总的来说，我们的发现说明：虽然语境灵活性（contextual flexibility）对模型来说一直很难，但类别知识在预训练里怎么表达，会极大影响模型能不能学到扎实的类别知识。

articles.title: CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
articles.zh: CoPre-MoE：在多模态持续指令微调中巩固并保留 MoE
articles.summary: 如果你在做多模态模型的持续微调，这篇讲的是怎么防止MoE专家在学新任务时把旧能力忘干净。
articles.author: Tao Hu, Ling-Xiang Zhang 等
articles.body: Multimodal continual instruction tuning requires multimodal large language models to sequentially acquire new capabilities without catastrophic forgetting. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures offer a promising way to mitigate task interference through expert specialization and combination. However, while existing MoE-based methods avoid overwriting shared parameters by allocating separate experts for each task, this progressive expansion incurs severe cross-task redundancy and linear parameter growth. Specifically, experts across tasks often learn overlapping functions alongside task-specific capabilities. For instance, ScienceQA and TextVQA both locate relevant image regions. To curb parameter redundancy without inducing forgetting, we propose Consolidating and Preserving MoE (CoPre-MoE). For each incoming task, CoPre-MoE first learns task-specific MoE to capture specialized capabilities. To eliminate redundancy and reduce parameter growth across tasks, we design a shared-and-private expert architecture. Specifically, we first evaluate functional overlap to selectively consolidate overlapping experts across tasks into a fixed-capacity generic expert pool. We then factorize the remaining task-specific experts into shared projection bases and compact task-specific cores within a private expert pool. To mitigate forgetting, we construct the router by pairing each expert with learnable retrieval keys, where historical keys remain frozen during continual updates while newly added keys are regularized with an orthogonality penalty. At inference, input-dependent routing dynamically combines both pools without test-time task labels. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CoPre-MoE achieves superior performance while substantially reducing parameter overhead.
articles.bodyZh: 多模态持续指令微调（multimodal continual instruction tuning）说白了，就是让多模态大语言模型（multimodal large language models）一个接一个学新本事，同时别把旧本事忘光，也就是避免灾难性遗忘（catastrophic forgetting）。专家混合架构（Mixture-of-experts, MoE）看起来是个好办法：让不同专家各管一摊，再把它们组合起来，从而减轻任务之间的互相干扰（task interference）。不过，现有基于 MoE 的方法虽然会给每个任务单独分配专家，避免覆盖共享参数，但这种不断加专家的做法会带来严重的跨任务冗余，参数量也会线性膨胀。具体说，不同任务的专家除了学任务专属能力，还经常学到重复的功能。比如 ScienceQA 和 TextVQA 都需要定位图片里相关的区域。为了在不让模型遗忘的前提下压住参数冗余，我们提出“整合与保留专家混合”方法（Consolidating and Preserving MoE, CoPre-MoE）。每来一个新任务，CoPre-MoE 先学一个任务专属的 MoE，把这项任务的特殊能力抓出来。为了消除冗余、减少跨任务带来的参数增长，我们设计了一种共享-私有专家架构（shared-and-private expert architecture）。具体做法是，先评估功能重叠度，把不同任务里功能重叠的专家有选择地整合进一个容量固定的通用专家池（generic expert pool）。然后，把剩下的任务专属专家拆成共享投影基（shared projection bases）和紧凑的任务专属核心（compact task-specific cores），放进私有专家池（private expert pool）。为了缓解遗忘，我们构建路由器（router）时，给每个专家配一个可学习检索键（learnable retrieval key）：持续更新过程中，历史键保持冻结，新加的键则用正交惩罚（orthogonality penalty）来约束。到了推理阶段，路由会根据输入动态组合这两个专家池，而且不需要测试时任务标签（test-time task labels）。大量实验表明，CoPre-MoE 不仅性能更强，还能大幅降低参数开销（parameter overhead）。

articles.title: LitArc-Bench: Disentangling Text-Specific Reader-Response Dynamics from Position and Lexical Affect
articles.zh: LitArc-Bench：将文本特有的读者反应动态与位置和词汇情感分离开来
articles.summary: 如果你在做LLM的读者反应或情感评测，这个基准提醒你：模型表现出的"情绪反应"可能只是文本位置和用词带来的假象。
articles.author: Mingming Su, Yushan Wei 等
articles.body: When model predictions track an unfolding human affect trajectory, alignment may reflect narrative position, affective words, or text-specific reader-response dynamics. We introduce LitArc-Bench to separate these explanations: 39 Chinese-language literary excerpts segmented into seven checkpoints, with 430 questionnaires from 81 adults in two classroom groups (9,020 VAD ratings). We compare three future-blind model runs with leave-one-text-out position priors, lexical affect, and human-human references. Position alone reaches r = .470 for arousal, making raw alignment insufficient. Yet all six V/A transition advantages over a joint position-lexicon control have text-bootstrap intervals above zero. Cross-fitted models match the correct human text better than 38 mismatched texts in all nine model-dimension cells (p < .0001); a text-invariant negative control returns chance (p = 1). On human transitions at least 0.5 points against the position trend, models recover 69-76% of valence directions and 53-68% for arousal and dominance. Under crossed participant-text resampling, all nine identity intervals remain above zero; joint-control advantages are robust for valence and directional but less certain for arousal. High shape agreement still coexists with scale bias. LitArc-Bench identifies which components of literary reader response are recoverable beyond shallow explanations and why shape, calibration, and human variability require separate evaluation.
articles.bodyZh: 当模型预测能跟上一段正在展开的人类情绪轨迹时，这种“对得上”（alignment）可能来自叙事位置（narrative position）、情感词（affective words），也可能来自特定文本引发的读者反应动态（text-specific reader-response dynamics）。我们推出 LitArc-Bench，就是要把这几种解释拆开：39 段中文文学选段，切成 7 个检查点（checkpoints），来自两个课堂小组的 81 名成年人填了 430 份问卷，共得到 9,020 条 VAD 评分（效价、唤醒度、支配度）。我们比较了三种“看不到未来信息”的模型运行（future-blind model runs），分别用留一文本位置先验（leave-one-text-out position priors）、词汇情感（lexical affect）和真人之间的参照（human-human references）。光靠位置，唤醒度（arousal）就能到 r = .470，所以原始的对齐程度还不够说明问题。但相对于“位置+词汇”的联合控制（joint position-lexicon control），六个 V/A（效价/唤醒度）转移优势的文本 bootstrap 区间（text-bootstrap intervals）全都高于零。交叉拟合模型（cross-fitted models）在全部九个“模型—维度”单元格（model-dimension cells）里，都把正确的人类文本匹配得比 38 个不匹配文本更好（p < .0001）；而不随文本变化的阴性对照（text-invariant negative control）则回到随机水平（p = 1）。在人类评分中那些逆着位置趋势、幅度至少 0.5 分的转变上，模型能还原 69–76% 的效价方向，唤醒度和支配度则是 53–68%。在参与者×文本交叉重采样（crossed participant-text resampling）下，九个“身份识别”区间（identity intervals）仍然全部高于零；联合控制带来的优势在效价和方向性上比较稳，在唤醒度上没那么确定。形状吻合度高，仍然可能和尺度偏差（scale bias）同时存在。LitArc-Bench 能帮我们看清：文学读者反应里哪些成分是能还原的、不是靠浅层解释就能糊弄过去的；也能看清为什么形状、校准（calibration）和人与人之间的差异需要分开评估。

articles.title: Gamer: A Generalist Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Long-Horizon Real-Time Game Agent
articles.zh: Gamer：面向长时程实时游戏 Agent 的通用视觉-语言-动作基础模型
articles.summary: 如果你在做游戏Agent，这篇给了一个能长时程实时游玩的VLA基座模型，值得看看它的动作建模是怎么设计的。
articles.author: Run Luo, Kuan Zhang 等
articles.body: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.
articles.bodyZh: 我们推出 Gamer，这是一套为复杂交互环境里的长周期任务（long-horizon tasks）打造的通用智能体框架（generalist agent framework）。它用端到端架构（end-to-end architecture）把感知（perception）、记忆管理（memory management）和多步推理（multi-step reasoning）串在一起，训练和部署共用一套流水线（training and deployment pipeline），既能和传统 2D 图形界面（2D graphical interfaces）交互，也能和复杂的 3D 模拟世界（3D simulated worlds）交互。我们先用几万小时设备层面的键鼠操作（device-level keyboard and mouse interaction）数据继续预训练（continue pre-training），这些轨迹（trajectories）覆盖模拟游戏和具身环境（embodied environments），让模型能同时学到物理世界和虚拟世界里的环境动态（environmental dynamics）。接着做稀疏思考指令微调（Sparse-thinking instruction tuning），既大幅减少冗余计算（redundant computation），又保留复杂决策所需的推理能力。我们用一种稳定的多轮强化学习（multi-turn reinforcement learning）方法来训练长周期交互策略（policy），专门应对有限上下文窗口（finite context windows）、采样轨迹累积误差（accumulated rollout errors）和稀疏奖励（sparse rewards）这些问题。为了做到实时交互，云边推理引擎（cloud-edge inference engine）能同时服务大量模拟游戏环境，支持无界上下文执行（unbounded-context execution），还能把在线推理延迟（online inference latency）压得很低。在多个有挑战的 3D 开放世界游戏（3D open-world games）里，Gamer 展现出扎实的泛化能力（generalization）和接近熟练玩家的运行效率（operational efficiency）；它在一系列传统 2D 游戏基准测试（2D game benchmarks）上也拿到了有竞争力的成绩。这些结果说明，哪怕是重复的键鼠轨迹，只要把数据和算法规模扩上去（scaling data and learning algorithms），也能带来明显提升。用这些轨迹来训练，能帮 Gamer 在兼具物理和数字特性（physical and digital properties）的环境里更稳地学会复杂技能。这条路也指向一种通用智能体（generalist agents），能在数字世界和物理世界之间来回交互。
